subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Diferenciar, em textos lidos e em produções próprias, o efeito de sentido do uso dos verbos de ligação “ser”, “estar”, “ficar”, “parecer” e “permanecer”.

components.description_pt: Identificar verbos de ligação ser, estar, ficar, parecer e permanecer em textos lidos
components.description_en: Identify linking verbs ser, estar, ficar, parecer, and permanecer in read texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in a given sentence

components.description_pt: Distinguir significado específico que cada verbo de ligação contribui para sentença
components.description_en: Distinguish the specific meaning each linking verb contributes to a sentence
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the specific function of a verbal within a particular sentence

components.description_pt: Explicar como substituir um verbo de ligação por outro altera efeito de significado de oração
components.description_en: Explain how substituting one linking verb for another alters the meaning effect of a clause
components.cc_component_description: Explain how a specific word choice affects the meaning or feeling of a sentence

components.description_pt: Aplicar verbo de ligação apropriado em própria escrita para produzir efeito de significado intencional
components.description_en: Apply the appropriate linking verb in one's own writing to produce an intended meaning effect
components.cc_component_description: Select precise word choices to achieve intended meaning or stylistic effect in writing

cc_matches.description: Explain the function of nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in general and their functions in particular sentences.
Explain the function of verbals (gerunds, participles, infinitives) in general and their function in particular sentences.
Apply knowledge of language to understand how language functions in different contexts, to make effective choices for meaning or style, and to comprehend more fully when reading or listening.
Choose words and phrases for effect.
